data.body: Patch release. Fixes MCPServer tool registration under async lifespans.
FastMCP is renamed to MCPServer and mcp.server.fastmcp is removed. Import MCPServer from mcp.server.mcpserver. See the migration guide.
Final v1 patch. Pin 'mcp<2' to stay on this line.
Adds streamable HTTP transport options to FastMCP.
Structured tool output and elicitation helpers.
